import pathlib,json,email,email.policy,email.utils,datetime,re,decimal,os
x=json.loads(pathlib.Path('store/jobs/j000322/out/gzip-utf-8-parsed.json').read_text())
m=email.message_from_bytes(pathlib.Path('store/jobs/j000067/out/confidential.eml').read_bytes(),policy=email.policy.default)
request=email.utils.parsedate_to_datetime(str(m['Date'])).astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)
rows=[]
for t in x['!blockchain!!v1!!txs!exodus_0:ethereum']:
 date=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(t['date'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
 amount=decimal.Decimal(re.match(r'^([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)',t['coinAmount']).group(1))
 rows.append({'amount_sign':'negative' if amount<0 else 'positive' if amount>0 else 'zero','stored_wallet_date':date.isoformat().replace('+00:00','Z'),'request_header_date':request.isoformat().replace('+00:00','Z'),'request_minus_wallet_seconds':int((request-date).total_seconds()),'wallet_timestamp_precedes_request_header':date<request})
res={'method':'Compare explicitly zoned wallet transaction date fields to retained MIME Date header; source clocks only, no external block-time verification or email-to-payment attribution.','rows':rows,'email_plain_body':[p.get_content().strip() for p in m.walk() if p.get_content_type()=='text/plain']}
pathlib.Path(os.environ['OUT'],'wallet-request-chronology.json').write_text(json.dumps(res,indent=2));print(json.dumps(res))
PY
